key_notes: Key 1 (t=4.2s): Initial archival pose of axe; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=5.33s): Mid-sequence articulation of axe; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=6.56s): Peak dynamic extension of axe over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.8s): Follow-through and settle of axe with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of axe (4.2s..7.8s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
